text_block_list.text: On the night of the race, I spotted Grass Wonder standing alone on the track.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Pathetic.
What an utterly disgraceful state to be in...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"If you are exhausted by something of this caliber,
you are far too unready to aim for the summit."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
More and more. So that I won't lose to anyone,
and won't lose to myself, I have to train—

She's clearly in a tight spot.
We might need to reconsider her upcoming race schedule...
